design.registry.try_ok: ✓ A sample install of {item} into a scratch project resolves: {files} file(s); packages: {packages}.
design.registry.try_failed: ✗ A sample install of {item} into a scratch project doesn't resolve:
design.registry.npx_ok: ✓ `npx shadcn add` installed {item} into a scratch project.
design.registry.summary: {items} item(s): {errors} problem(s) to fix before a release, {warnings} to look at.
design.tools.which: system_tools runs {commands}: `args` starts with one of them.
design.tools.own_folder: {flag}: system_tools works in your worktree only.
design.tools.too_long: equipe design ran for 20 minutes and was stopped: ask for fewer components or widths a call.
app.run_reason_lease_expired: Its turn ended without a hand-in or a wait, and nothing has run it since.
app.run_reason_not_resumed: equipe restarted and couldn't carry it on: its member is gone, or its engine can't resume here.
app.run_reason_migrated: In progress from before equipe kept runs, and nothing could carry it on.
app.run_paused_why: Nothing runs it right now ({who}). If that lasts, equipe marks it stalled.
app.run_queued_for: Brought back on the same branch and worktree; it starts when {who} is free.
app.run_kept: The branch, worktree, commit and uncommitted files are kept as they are. No new ticket is made.
app.ask_resume_run: Resume T-{id} with {who} in a fresh session, on the same branch and worktree? y / n
app.ask_requeue_run: Requeue T-{id} for the next free {role}, on the same branch and worktree? y / n
app.ask_reassign_run: Who takes T-{id} over, on the same branch and worktree? {members} · n
commands.rest: Rest a member: no new work until woken
commands.rest_stop: and stop what it works on now
commands.rest_off: wake it: it takes new work again
app.rest_usage: /rest <member> — no new work, what it works on finishes · /rest <member> stop — stops that too · /rest <member> off — wakes it
app.pm_rests: The PM stays on duty: it can't rest.
app.run_pause_limit: Paused: {engine} reached its usage limit. It goes on by itself once {engine} has room.
app.run_pause_limit_at: Paused: {engine} reached its usage limit. It goes on by itself in {span}.
app.run_pause_limit_moves: Paused: {engine} reached its usage limit. It carries on on {to}.
app.run_pause_retry: Its engine failed ({cause}). equipe tries again by itself in {span}.
app.run_pause_squad: Paused with the squad: several engines failed at once ({cause}). It goes on once a test turn works.
app.run_pause_sign_in: Paused: {engine}'s sign-in stopped working here. It goes on once signed in again.
desktop.check_session: Someone is logged in at the Mac's screen
desktop.fix_session: log in at the Mac (or over Screen Sharing / Jump Desktop): the helper only runs in that session
desktop.check_daemon: The daemon runs as a login service in that session
desktop.fix_daemon: equipe daemon install (while logged in at the Mac)
desktop.check_helper: The desktop helper is installed and running
desktop.check_accessibility: Accessibility (reading apps and acting in them)
desktop.fix_accessibility: switch on "{name}" and confirm with your password or Touch ID
desktop.fix_post_events: switch Accessibility on, then run setup again
desktop.fix_engine_missing: equipe downloads it by itself and checks its checksum (or run equipe desktop setup now)
desktop.fix_engine_tampered: it doesn't match its pinned checksum and won't run: equipe installs it again by itself, or run equipe desktop setup now
desktop.check_engine_grant: The engine works under the helper's Accessibility permission
desktop.fix_engine_grant: switch Accessibility on for "{name}", then run equipe desktop setup again
desktop.check_screen: Screen & System Audio Recording (only for screenshots)
desktop.fix_screen: optional: switch on "{name}" so members can take screenshots and you see the screen when asked
desktop.fix_no_display: no screen attached: plug in a monitor or an HDMI dummy plug, or use a virtual display
desktop.fix_unlocked: the Mac is locked: members can't work until it is unlocked
desktop.no_members: No member works the desktop yet: equipe desktop on <member>
desktop.removed: The desktop helper is stopped and removed.
desktop.remove_note: To take its permissions back too: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility (and Screen & System Audio Recording), select "{name}" and remove it with −.
desktop.locked_bad: Say on or off: equipe desktop locked on
desktop.locked_on: Work while the screen is locked: on. Members act in apps through the accessibility tree even while this Mac is locked.
desktop.locked_off: Work while the screen is locked: off. Members wait for an unlocked screen before acting in apps.
desktop.locked_off_hint: Members wait for an unlocked screen (an unattended Mac: equipe desktop locked on).
desktop.locked_note: Clicks, typing and screenshots still wait for an unlocked screen: macOS sends them to the lock screen. Your gates stay: sending in your name still asks you, and payment, password and security screens are never touched.
desktop.on_everyone: Everyone on {squad} works this Mac's desktop again, once Accessibility is on.
desktop.off_everyone: Nobody on {squad} works the desktop now, except members you turn on by name.
desktop.on_member: {member} works this Mac's desktop from its next turn.
desktop.on_note: Each action is checked against the app it means; sending something in your name asks you first, and payment, password and security screens are never touched.
desktop.off_member: {member} no longer works the desktop, from its next turn.
desktop.fix_unlocked_working: locked: members act through the accessibility tree meanwhile (work while locked is on); clicks and typing wait
desktop.check_host_app: Desktop control runs as equipe itself: one entry in System Settings
desktop.fix_host_handed: equipe isn't allowed Accessibility yet, so the older "{name}" keeps working meanwhile; switch on "equipe" and the old one isn't needed
desktop.check_host_bundle: Desktop control runs as the "{name}" helper (equipe.app isn't installed on this Mac)
desktop.old_row: The old "equipe Desktop Helper" isn't used any more: you can remove its row in System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility (select it, then −).
desktop.members_until_granted: Working the desktop: everyone, once Accessibility is on
desktop.signing_failed: Couldn't sign the desktop helper: macOS wouldn't let codesign use its private signing key. Run equipe desktop setup at the Mac's own screen (not over SSH), or install equipe.app, which needs no signing. Details: {detail}
desktop.installed_app: The desktop helper is equipe.app itself: nothing to install or sign.
desktop.engine_failed: Couldn't install agent-desktop: {why}. The screenshot tools still work; equipe tries again by itself, or run equipe desktop setup to retry now.
desktop.guide_intro: macOS asks you — at the Mac's own screen — to allow "{name}". Members never get these permissions themselves: equipe acts for them, through its own checks. The accessibility engine runs under the same permission, so there is nothing else to allow.
desktop.guide_accessibility: {step}. System Settings › Privacy & Security › Accessibility: switch on "{name}". The switch only takes once you confirm with your password or Touch ID.
desktop.guide_screen: {step}. Optional, for screenshots: System Settings › Privacy & Security › Screen & System Audio Recording: switch on "{name}". If macOS asks whether it may bypass the private window picker, choose Allow.
desktop.guide_signed: Already listed and switched on, but still ✗? It was signed differently before: remove it with −, then run equipe desktop setup again.
logins.bad_since: Couldn't read --since {since}: use 7d, 24h, 2w or a day like 2026-11-01.
logins.none: You weren't asked to sign in for members since {since}.
logins.heading: Sign-ins and checks you were asked to do in members' browsers since {since}: {count}
logins.lasts: How long a sign-in lasted before the site asked again (median):
logins.repeats: Asked again within a day by another member for the same site: {count} ({sites})
logins.repeats_none: No site was asked for again within a day by another member.
logins.signed_in: Sign-ins finished: {count}, {equipe} of them by equipe itself with a kept login ({percent}%)
logins.signed_in_none: No sign-in finished on record yet.
desktop.auto_note: From now on the daemon does this by itself: it installs the engine and the helper, and shows you the one switch. This command just does it right away.
onboard.desktop_note: Optional: let members work the apps on this Mac. equipe installs what it needs by itself; macOS asks you for one switch (Accessibility for "equipe"). Skip it and equipe offers it again when a member first needs it.
onboard.desktop_skipped: Skipped. equipe offers it again when a member first needs desktop apps.
onboard.desktop_later: Desktop apps aren't ready yet: {why} equipe carries on by itself, and you can finish later in Settings › Squad › Desktop apps.
logins.autopilot: equipe's own steps: {steps} — about {minutes} minutes of yours saved.
credential.refused: equipe credential gives a key only to the AWS CLI's credential_process, never to a member's command.
credential.missing: No AWS key is kept for the profile {name} (Settings › Accounts › Login autopilot).
credential.unknown: equipe credential knows aws only, not {kind}.
telegram.captcha: A CAPTCHA waits for you in {member}'s browser. Open equipe and solve it; {member} carries on by itself afterwards.
main.browser_panel_1: The page opened in the equipe app's browser panel. Sign in — or sign up — there:
main.browser_panel_2: once is enough, and equipe offers to keep the login when you're done.
usage.bad_since: Couldn't read --since {since}: use 7d, 24h, 2w or a day like 2026-11-01.
usage.heading: Token usage of {squad}, {from} to {to} (UTC): {tokens} in {turns} turns
usage.split: Input {input} · output {output} · cache read {read} · cache write {write}
usage.unsplit: {tokens} of the total come from older turns kept only as a sum, with no split by kind.
usage.by_member: By member (lanes folded into their member):
usage.context: Context per call (what one request carries in):
usage.signals_none: No waste signals over their thresholds.
usage.digest_on: The daily usage note is on for {squad}: once a day, only when a waste signal is over its threshold.
usage.digest_off: The daily usage note is off for {squad}.
usage.bad_digest: Say on or off: equipe usage digest on

usage.q_send_backs: Send-backs per accepted ticket: {value} ({count} in all)
usage.q_reasons: Send-backs kept in the window, by reason: {reasons}
